name: X (Twitter)
summary: Post to X and read mentions. X charges per call; prefer Threads, Bluesky or Mastodon for free posting.

actions.name: Read X profile
actions.description: Reads the connected X account’s handle, name and follower counts.

actions.name: List mentions
actions.description: Lists recent posts that mention the account.

params.name: paginationToken
params.description: Page token returned by the previous call

actions.name: Read post metrics
actions.description: Reads impressions, likes, reposts and replies for posts.

actions.name: Post on X
actions.description: Publishes a post (up to 280 characters) with up to 4 images. Each post costs X credits.

actions.name: Reply on X
actions.description: Replies to a post. Each reply costs X credits.

actions.name: Delete a post on X
actions.description: Permanently deletes one of the account’s posts.
